exact_statement: Let h be a balanced uniform Boolean core with a supplied actual certificate H(h)<=4I(h), F_h=(-1)^a on x=0, h on x=b=1, and +1 otherwise. Let M be the completed matched-marginal canonical nonempty occupancy reference of F_h, A=KL(P||M)=(15/16)K_occ. Query b first, then any finite adaptive fresh data-only continuation in b1, retaining b0 and keeping x,a unqueried. Assume every terminal core g has a supplied actual H(g)<=4I(g) certificate. Use one unchanged original M, its actual coherent kernels and fair source-zero fallback, retaining all reference-only rows and full terminal entropy. Write S=E(4Ileaf-Hleaf), Sroot=4Iroot-Hroot, R=Iroot-EIleaf, D=Hroot-EHleaf, L=A+[D-4R]_+, and G=h2(1/4)+sum_j h2(Inf_j(h)/4). Then S-L=min(S-A,Sroot-A)>=2-A>=3+H(h)/4-G. Hence G<3+H(h)/4 is sufficient for complete same-owner payment. In particular, for h_m=chi_z*(1-2*1[y_1=...=y_m=0]), every integer m>=3 and every such finite adaptive data history have G(h_m)<85/32 and S-L>11/32+H(h_m)/4. All required core certificates hold under arbitrary data restrictions; h_m is genuinely non-flat and balanced. An already booked conservative overpayment 0<=omega<=11/32 is additionally paid as L+omega from the same S, with strictly positive remainder. At m=3 G>2, so the old sufficient marginal threshold G<2 fails while the exact source is admitted. The preceding general balanced-core statement concerns only the data-only scope just specified. Additional theorem for the stated h_m family: query b first and keep b0 untouched; inside b1 allow any finite adaptive fresh data/x tree, with x exposed on EVERY terminal path and a never queried. Transport the SAME original M through the entire physical tree using the same coherent/fair-zero-row kernels. After that tree, prescribe completed canonical occupancy references at every b1 terminal and keep the inherited reference at b0. For original physical terminal probabilities p_l let Knew_l and Kold_l be the full new and inherited terminal KLs, B=sum_reset p_l Knew_l and Creset=sum_reset p_l [Knew_l-Kold_l]_+. Then A<39/32, S>=2, Sroot>=2, 0<=Creset<=B<=7/32, and S-(L+omega+B)>7/32 for every 0<=omega<=11/32. All inherited terminal KL remains included in A, and the full new terminal KL is conservatively added; no original credit or previously spent influence allowance is renewed. The bound follows from an all-k canonical reset cost <=7/8 for character-point-defect restrictions and total core-terminal physical weight1/4. This does not cover a queries, additional queries after the reset, second resets, arbitrary-core supplier certificates or full FEI. For direct continuation of ANY previously paid data-only frontier, append x at every b1 leaf and reset immediately: the old L is exactly unchanged by x and is retained in full. For more general mixed-history eligibility, omega must include EVERY actual earlier conservative booking beyond final whole L; the omega bound is not automatic permission to retire a booked positive component.
